scope: Evidence from other open-source TV projects is research, not Tigris hardware certification. Read-only guidance only.

mechanisms: Android native HOME may work; some China firmware keeps a higher-priority stock HOME
Stock HOME activity-alias and actual window class can differ
inspect: HOME candidates and resolved component
Guard binding and stock HOME activity-alias
Physical remote Home and cold boot
records.fallback: Existing Standard HOME then verified Guard. No Sony adapter changes.

mechanisms: MT5879 verifier may refuse adb install and HOME-declaring APK; Guard and authorized T-Cast path
MT5879 firmware can block third-party autostart via APP_AUTO_START/APP_ASSOC_START
m7221 has separate boot property persist.sys.launcher.component; Aerial example runs Android 8, unsupported by current Tigris
MT9655 reports TLS-only ADB without on-TV pairing, so APK push may succeed without HOME takeover
inspect: ro.board.platform / ro.hardware / exact build fingerprint
Installer error code and ability to authorize ADB
Stock HOME resolver and actual remote behavior
Whether TCL appops and Guard are really active
records.fallback: Preserve Tigris existing TCL Standard/Guard/T-Cast route; choose alternate install only after actual verifier failure. Never automatically write boot properties.

examples.summary: Aerial reported verifier-based APK restriction and TCL autostart AppOps on one MT5879 line
Aerial reported a separate boot launcher property on Android 8; Tigris Android 9 minimum still applies
Aerial reported TLS-only ADB access and device-side Guard install without HOME authorization

mechanisms: PatchWall firmware HOME allowlist may ignore successful preferred-home commands
Standby may force-stop apps and disconnect Guard; listener binding depends on low-RAM and Android version
Disabling PatchWall can expose a broken FallbackHome
inspect: Exact firmware fingerprint; MIUI/HyperOS evidence
PatchWall/FallbackHome presence and current resolver
Accessibility binding, listener availability and low-RAM status
Physical Home / wake / reboot
records.fallback: Use existing xiaomi_home.py read-only diagnostics and opt-in reversible probe; do not disable OEM HOME or introduce an unverified sync adapter.

examples.summary: Aerial reported PatchWall allowlist and standby process stops; inspect, do not generalize to other firmware
Aerial reported a low-RAM Android 9 listener limitation; observed model does not prove current listener status

mechanisms: Some firmwares boot explicit DEFAULT_HOMEPAGE from vendor configuration rather than Android HOME
Some expose HOME.CC category or a home without any HOME intent
Some block background start and can force-stop third-party apps; Android 13 examples have black-screen/ANR
inspect: ro.build.version.incremental / ro.board.platform
HOME resolver versus actual cold-boot frontend
Existing original launcher, app focus and Guard binding
records.fallback: APK-only + read-only diagnosis until an exact firmware route and rollback are verified; never edit system XML or setprop as a generic workaround.

mechanisms: On some Android-based VIDAA_TV builds, persist.vt.use_home_pkg controls hardware Home independently of Android HOME resolver
Cold boot may still be controlled by the OEM and start stock launcher
Native VIDAA is not an Android APK target
inspect: Verify this is Android SDK 28+ rather than native VIDAA
Read-only check of persist.vt.use_home_pkg where present
Physical Home, boot, Guard events and original value
records.fallback: APK-only and inspect first. A firmware-scoped property trial requires a fresh permission and exact-value rollback, never execute from a brand match.

examples.summary: Some Android-based VIDAA_TV builds expose a distinct HOME-routing system property

mechanisms: ColorOS TV K9 example limits which APK identities may declare HOME and requires a vendor category at boot
Guard may be installable even if Standard is rejected; no evidence that this always replaces HOME
inspect: ColorOS TV version and build
APK install rejection code
Authorized ADB and HOME candidate/resolver
records.fallback: APK-only safe path and explicit limitations. Never spoof a system/other app package name or disable stock HOME automatically.

examples.summary: Aerial reported restricted launcher identity and vendor HOME category on this ColorOS TV family

mechanisms: Some GMUI models hide ADB toggles; device-specific authorized enablement may be needed
Long Home can clean memory, causing fallback to stock launcher
inspect: Check whether ADB is authorized before installation
Actual HOME resolver, Guard status and physical long Home
records.fallback: APK-only / device-approved installer and manual ADB setup. Never turn on a hidden debug service without user authorization.

mechanisms: Some Konka file managers reject third-party APK first installs while the system installer accepts in-app upgrades
HOME resolver may remain Konka, requiring Guard on selected firmwares
inspect: ADB availability and install error details
HOME/Guard binding and actual remote behavior
Official signing identity for in-place updates
records.fallback: APK-only diagnostic path; preserve installed package/user data, never uninstall to work around a signature mismatch.

mechanisms: Some eUI builds repeatedly stop third-party launchers; aggressive Guard revival may steal focus from a different app
inspect: Look for repeated process kills/revivals in a limited time window
Confirm current foreground is stock HOME before Guard attempts takeover
records.fallback: APK-only until actual guard activity can be verified; avoid unconditional takeover on unknown foreground windows.

mechanisms: Standard HOME when Android allows it; some boxes/projectors modify HOME resolution or ADB availability
inspect: Exact Android SDK and fingerprint
HOME candidates and resolver
APK installation, actual physical Home and boot/wake
records.fallback: Use existing generic Android APK-only route; never infer vendor privileges from brand labels.
